diffs.patch:
Index: .github/workflows/build.yml
===================================================================
--- .github/workflows/build.yml	
+++ .github/workflows/build.yml	
@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+name: Build
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+  pull_request:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  build:
+    name: Build
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Set up Node.js
+        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 20
+          cache: npm
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: npm ci
+
+      - name: Build
+        run: npm run build
+
+      - name: Upload build output
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: build-output
+          path: dist/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 14

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Upload build output
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: dist/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
